about.title: A Leiden institution since 1938
about.text: Schaap's Vishandel has been on Herenstraat in Leiden since 1938. Four generations of craftsmanship, honest fish and a personal story. Aldert Haasnoot — known in the neighbourhood simply as 'Schaap' — is ready every day to help you.

varlaksHighlight.title: Varlaks — organic salmon from the far north
varlaksHighlight.bullet1: No antibiotics, no GMO, no hormones
varlaksHighlight.bullet2: Family farms above the Arctic Circle in Norway
varlaksHighlight.bullet3: Fully traceable from egg to fillet

verhaalPage.heroTitle: From Gerrit Schaap to the fourth generation
verhaalPage.intro: For almost ninety years, a small, cosy fish shop on Herenstraat in Leiden has fed, delighted and connected generations of Leiden residents. Schaap's Vishandel is not just a shop — it is a piece of Leiden history.
verhaalPage.t1text: Gerrit Schaap opens his fish shop at Herenstraat 48 in Leiden. At a time when fish truly came fresh from the boat and every Leiden resident had their own fishmonger, Gerrit lays the foundation for what would grow into a city institution.
verhaalPage.t2text: Young Cor Haasnoot starts working for Mr Schaap at just thirteen years old. He learns the trade from the ground up and takes over the business in 1957. The name 'Schaap' stays — a tribute to the founder who has become inseparably linked to the shop.
verhaalPage.t3text: Aldert Haasnoot — known simply as 'Schaap' in the neighbourhood — has stood behind the counter his entire life. In 2009 he officially takes over from his father, bringing the shop into the 21st century while preserving the atmosphere Leiden residents cherish: personal, warm, honest.
verhaalPage.t3quote: People come here not just for the fish, but for the conversation. Sometimes it's like a village pub in here. — Aldert Haasnoot
verhaalPage.t4text: On 1 January 2018, Schaap's Vis turns 80. The whole city celebrates. Customers send in photos and memories for an anniversary book. One of the most charming: Ria Verburg, who collected kibbeling monthly for the nursery and always came back for Mr Schaap's joke.
verhaalPage.t4quote: When picking up he always said: 'a box of kibbeling for the orphanage!' It always made me laugh. — Ria Verburg
verhaalPage.t5title: Today — ready for the next generation
verhaalPage.t5text: Schaap's Vis is preparing for its fourth generation. Alongside the shop on Herenstraat, the team now also appears at the Leiden market (Wednesday and Saturday) and at Hoogvliet in Voorschoten on Fridays. The range has grown — but the warmth has remained.
verhaalPage.outroQuote: We are a lovely old little shop. Not everything has to be brand new and spick and span.

varlaksPage.heroTitle: Varlaks — organic salmon from the Arctic waters of Norway
varlaksPage.heroSub: Free from antibiotics, hormones and GMO. Pure nature — you can taste it.
varlaksPage.story: We already had a good range. But when we discovered Varlaks, we knew this was something different. Not a large company, not an anonymous farm — but small-scale family farms above the Arctic Circle in Norway, where the salmon simply have the space to grow. Slowly, in clean water, without shortcuts. You can taste it. The texture is firmer, the flavour purer. No additives to mask the taste — because there simply aren't any. We are proud to offer this at Schaap's Vis. Come and taste the difference.
varlaksPage.f1text: The salmon grow in the ice-cold, oxygen-rich waters of northern Norway. The current of cold mountain water keeps the water pure and clean — ideal conditions for salmon that grow slowly and naturally.
varlaksPage.f2text: Varlaks works exclusively with carefully selected family businesses. Farms are visited personally each year to guarantee quality and sustainability. From egg to end product — fully traceable.
varlaksPage.f3title: No antibiotics, no GMO, no hormones
varlaksPage.f3text: Thanks to low stocking density and the pure environment, antibiotics simply have no place in this farming concept. The salmon grow with natural feed, plenty of space and no chemical additives.
varlaksPage.f4text: From the farm in Norway to your plate: every piece of Varlaks salmon is fully traceable. You know exactly what you're eating and where it comes from.
varlaksPage.ctaText: Varlaks salmon is available daily in our shop on Herenstraat, at the Leiden market (Wednesday & Saturday) and at Hoogvliet Voorschoten on Friday.
varlaksPage.label: Organic salmon from northern Norway
varlaksPage.storyTitle: Why we sell this salmon in particular

wel.d: Above the Arctic Circle near Bodø. Cold, clean, oxygen-rich water — one of the few places where salmon is allowed to grow slowly.
Two family businesses: Wenberg Fiskeoppdrett in Fauske and Edelfarm in Saltdal. Few fish per pen, not large-scale industry.
The international standard for responsible aquaculture. Seafood Watch gives Skjerstadfjorden its highest environmental rating.
Every step is documented. Processed at Salten Salmon in Bodø, checked by independent certifiers.
Underwater cameras watch day and night. Spot a sea louse and a laser pulse deals with it. Nothing goes into the water.
Nearly all farmed salmon turns pink from synthetic astaxanthin made from petrochemicals. Varlaks uses the natural version, grown from fermented bacteria.

niet.d: The clean water and low stocking density make them unnecessary.
No pesticides and no artificial agents in the water.
Grows at its own pace, not artificially sped up.

eerlijkeVisPage.heroSub: Organic Varlaks salmon, MSC- and ASC-certified fish. Sustainable, honest and transparent — even when the story isn't perfect.
eerlijkeVisPage.whyText1: At Schaap's Vis it's not just about fresh and delicious — it's also about how the fish got to your plate. We consciously work with suppliers who put transparency, animal welfare and sustainability first.
eerlijkeVisPage.whyText2: That means traceable fish. Fish caught or farmed with respect for the sea. Fish where you know what's in it — and what isn't.
eerlijkeVisPage.cert1desc: Marine Stewardship Council — the international label for sustainable wild fisheries. Fishermen don't catch more than the sea can handle.
eerlijkeVisPage.cert2desc: Aquaculture Stewardship Council — the label for responsible farmed fish. Less environmental impact, better conditions for the fish.
eerlijkeVisPage.cert3desc: No antibiotics, no hormones, no genetically modified ingredients. Pure nature — as it was meant to be.
eerlijkeVisPage.cert4desc: From sea to counter. You can trace the origin of every fish we sell — we are transparent about every product in our range.
eerlijkeVisPage.varlaksText: The most special fish in our range is the Varlaks organic salmon. Raised by family farmers above the Arctic Circle in Norway, without antibiotics or GMO, in the coldest and cleanest water in the world. No shortcuts, no surprises.
eerlijkeVisPage.listSub: Below you will find all the fish we have consciously selected — each with its own story.
eerlijkeVisPage.comingSoonText: We are compiling the full list of all our sustainable fish — from MSC-certified cod to organic trout. Come back for the full overview, or visit us in the shop.
eerlijkeVisPage.ctaText: Not sure which fish is the best choice? We are happy to help — every day in the shop at Herenstraat 48, Leiden.

home.inleiding: Four generations behind the same counter. Gerrit Schaap started in 1938; Aldert runs it now. New deliveries every morning, at the shop on Herenstraat, at the Leiden market and on Fridays in Voorschoten.
home.bezorgKop: And these days we bring it to you too
home.bezorgTekst: Not everything we sell travels well. Fried fish goes soft within twenty minutes, so kibbeling and lekkerbek stay in the shop. What we do deliver is fresh fish from the auction and seafood platters — packed cold and driven out by us.
home.bezorgWel1: Fresh fish, filleted or whole, however you want it
home.bezorgWel2: Seafood platters for drinks or a party
home.bezorgNiet2: Hot fish soup and loose snacks
home.visschaalKop: Three seafood platters — add what you like
home.visschaalTekst: A drinks platter for four to six, a family platter, or the big party platter with oysters and prawns. You see exactly what is on each. Want something extra — more prawns, a dozen oysters — you add it yourself and the price moves along.
home.verhaalKop: Gerrit Schaap started it, we keep it going
home.verhaalTekst: Gerrit Schaap opened the shop in 1938. Cor Haasnoot started working here at thirteen and took over in 1957. His son Aldert runs it now — everyone in the neighbourhood simply calls him 'Schaap'. The name above the door never changed.
home.verhaalCitaat: We are an old, friendly little shop. Not everything has to be new and spotless.
home.assortimentTekst: The catch decides the range, so this changes. Ask in the shop or give us a ring — we will tell you honestly what is best today.
home.biologischKop: We know where it came from
home.biologischTekst: MSC for wild-caught fish, ASC for farmed, and Varlaks: organic salmon from family farms above the Arctic Circle, raised without antibiotics. Not for the label on the shelf, but so we can tell you the story if you ask.
home.pijlerGebakkenTekst: Kibbeling and lekkerbek, hot from the pan. What Leiden has known us for longest.
home.pijlerVersTekst: From the auction to the counter. Whole, filleted or in steaks — however you like it.
home.pijlerSchaalTekst: Three platters for drinks, a birthday or Christmas.
home.gebakkenTekst: Kibbeling, lekkerbek and fried fish. Fresh in the pan every day, in a box to take away, with garlic sauce if you like. This is what most people walk in for the first time.
home.gebakkenNiet: We deliberately do not deliver this. Fried fish goes soft after twenty minutes in a box, and then we would be selling you something we would not eat ourselves. You have it here the way it is meant to be: hot and crisp.

Fried fish stays in the shop — kibbeling in a box for twenty minutes simply is not good any more, and then we would rather not.

faq.v: Do you deliver in my area?
faq.a: We deliver in Leiden, Leiderdorp, Voorschoten, Wassenaar and Leidschendam. Enter your postcode on this page and you will see straight away. Live just outside? Call us on +31 71 514 9802 — if it is on the route, we usually just do it.
€ 5.99 anywhere in our delivery area — whether you live in the centre of Leiden or in Wassenaar. Order € 35 or more and delivery is free. The minimum order is € 25.
Wednesday to Saturday. You pick a slot: 09:00–12:00, 12:00–15:00 or 15:00–18:00. Order by 12:00 the day before and we will buy it at the auction for you.

faq.v: What do you deliver, and what not?
faq.a: Fresh fish and seafood platters. Fried fish such as kibbeling and lekkerbek stays in the shop: after twenty minutes in a box it simply is not good any more. You can order it and collect it at Herenstraat 48.

faq.v: How do I know the price if fish is sold by weight?
faq.a: We only know once it is on the scales. That is why we ring you with the price before we pack. Nothing goes in the box until you agree.
For now you pay the driver: card or cash. We are setting up SumUp so that you will soon be able to pay in advance with iDEAL, credit card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.

faq.v: Does the fish stay cold on the way?
faq.a: Yes. Everything goes into a cool box with ice and we drive ourselves, so the fish is in the van for at most half an hour to forty-five minutes. No courier, no sorting depot.

faq.v: What does a seafood platter cost?
faq.a: The drinks platter starts at € 55.90 for four to six people. Above that come the family platter and the party platter. Whatever you add comes on top, per 100 grams — smoked salmon € 3.25 per 100 grams, Dutch prawns € 4.25. The price moves along as you pick.

faq.v: How many people does a platter feed?
faq.a: It says so on each platter. As a rule of thumb, count 150 grams of fish per person when there is other food too, and 250 grams when the platter is the meal. In doubt between two sizes, take the larger one — an empty platter is worse than leftovers.
Yes. Pick a platter and add whatever you like. Want something taken off instead, ring or message us and we will sort it while we lay it out.

faq.v: How far in advance should I order?
faq.a: A few days ahead is helpful. It is busy around Christmas and New Year, so order well in time then. For oysters we prefer about three days' notice.

faq.v: Can you allow for an allergy?
faq.a: Certainly. Tell us with your order: no shellfish, no raw fish, or a portion kept separate. If we know, we arrange it.

site.varlaksText: Choose a portion to suit your recipe. We can advise on quantities and preparation at the counter. Origin and any certification must match the batch supplied; please ask to see the label.
site.storyIntro: A Leiden fishmonger with a long history. Find us at Herenstraat 48, in our shop and at the market.
site.story1938: Mr Schaap started his fish business in Leiden in 1938. His name has stayed with the shop.
site.storyNow: Today, Schaap’s is about fish and personal service: advice on your choice, quantities and preparation. Visit us on Herenstraat or at one of our market stalls.
site.homeIntro: Schaap’s has been part of Leiden since 1938. Visit Herenstraat for fresh fish, herring, fried fish, salads and seafood platters. We are happy to help you choose for dinner or a gathering.
site.homeStory: From its beginnings in 1938 to the shop today, Schaap’s is part of Leiden. Personal service at the counter remains at its heart.
site.friedText: Try kibbeling (battered fish bites), lekkerbek (a battered fish fillet) or Dutch herring. Visit our shop or market stall for today’s selection.
site.reviewText: Read current visitor reviews on Google.
site.catalogIntro: From fresh fish to salads and prepared dishes. The selection may vary by day and season. Browse our products or ask what is available today.
site.searchPlaceholder: For example salmon, cod or salad
site.noResults: No products found. Try another search term.
site.productDesc: {name} at Schaap’s fishmonger, Herenstraat 48 in Leiden. Browse product information and ask about the current selection.
site.productAvailability: The selection varies. Check current availability in the online store or call the shop.
site.ingredientsText: Ask for ingredients, allergens, origin and storage or cooking instructions for the current product. These may vary by batch or recipe.
site.inspirationText: Looking for ideas? Browse our recipes or ask for advice at the counter.
site.thankText: Find your order and payment status in the confirmation from the SumUp online store. This page does not confirm an order or payment. Please contact the shop if you have questions.
site.contactFallback: Please call with your question. The online contact form is currently unavailable.
site.locationsIntro: Herenstraat 48 in Leiden, the Leiden market and our Friday stall in Voorschoten. See where and when to find us.
site.pickupText: Would you like us to set something aside? Call to arrange the collection point and time.
site.localLeidenIntro: Fresh fish, herring, fried fish, salads and seafood platters at Schaap’s. Part of Leiden since 1938.
site.localMarketIntro: Find our fish stall in Leiden on Wednesdays and Saturdays. Check the market days and directions, or call to arrange collection.
site.localVoorschotenIntro: On Fridays our stall is at Hoogvliet in Voorschoten. Come for fish and personal advice. Home delivery is on Thursdays only.
site.footerNote: Leiden since 1938 · fresh fish, salads and seafood platters delivered on Thursdays
